places.name: Open Rice
places.why: One of the few places in town still running old-school push-cart dim sum on weekends, plus a rotating chef's-special menu with dishes like ginger scallion lobster; two locations (Metropolitan and Rea Rd in Blakeney).
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate feature 2026-10-26 describes current weekend cart service at both locations)

places.name: Mano Bella
places.area: SouthPark (Morrison Place); stall at The Market at 7th Street, Uptown
places.address: 721 Governor Morrison St Ste 150, Charlotte, NC 28211
places.why: Small from-scratch pasta maker that has grown into a SouthPark eatery and an Uptown market counter; go for the beef ragu, ravioli or the house-smoked pancetta PLT, and watch for its pasta and mozzarella classes.
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate feature 2026-10-30 on both current locations; Toast ordering page live for SouthPark)
